progress_max_shots_per_second.description: Most shots a person can take in a second. Sets faster than this are ignored in stats.

progress_max_session_seconds.description: Most training seconds one workout can earn (3 hours).

progress_max_day_seconds.description: Most training seconds one player can earn in a day (4 hours).

progress_level_one_seconds.description: Seconds of training for skill level 1 (1 hour).

progress_level_growth.description: How many times more training each skill level needs than the one before (level 10 is about 90 hours).
